notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29396969/f39c474ec1815fa361cbc9bbb3b47fd93965ba96.jpg

Long story short - we're streamlining our operation, legally speaking, from our end and we had to add Acram Digital Sp. z o.o. (which would translate to Acram Digital Ltd.) to our privacy policy.

Once you launch the game, once the update goes through that is, you'll be faced with a pop-up message about just that. If you continue past that message you will have conceded to our new updated Privacy Policy.

But as I have mentioned, nothing apart from this addition has changed in it, so do not worry!

Should you be interested, you can read our Privacy Policy HERE.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.6
notes.notes:
Following the big multiplayer overhaul of the patch 1.2.5 we introduce following, smaller fixes: 

- A rare issue of the game crashing during bidding stage in Online play was fixed.
- A rare issue of the open rooms list incorrectly displaying rooms having zero players was fixed.
- A fix to the loading of the saved online games. The game will load on the correct tab and with no visual issues.
- Small fixes to the German translation.
- Players who left the game will be marked as such in players panel (greyed out icon).

notes.title: Eight-Minute Empire August 2019 Update - Online Play Overhaul
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29396969/1642b9ca5c48b49eb71b3f4e7644d2afb9a0a1f3.png

Good news! Per popular demand, we introduce a rework to the Online Play in Eight-Minute Empire! Its goal is to improve the quality of life during online play by adding some much asked for features and functionalities.

The changes are as follows:
- Asynchronous play - an inactive player will be removed by the server after 48 hours without making a move. No more unfinished games limbo! 
- When creating a room a maximum amount of players can be set. 
- The games will start automatically once the maximum amount of players is reached. The creator of a room no longer has to manually start the game.
- Synchronous play - the timer has been reworked. Now a player will be removed from the game only if they go offline (willingly or due to a disconnect) for three minutes. 
- Fixed a bug that caused some players not seeing certain rooms from the Open Rooms list.
- Soon - possible cross-platform online play with the Nintendo Switch players (27.08.2019).

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 is here with a free Map!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29396969/9dffbf804532f9753f3da823fd4e668f3795e4ad.png
We are happy to announce that we fixed some minor and major bugs. On the top of that, we added Steam achievements. To celebrate this, we are also giving you a map to play for free! 

What changed? 

- Old Europe map is free for everyone.

- You can join any room and play an online game, even if you don't have a particular map. 

- Added Play Again button for online games.

- Added timer for a synchronous mode.

- Improved recruitment animation.

- Fixed full screen Linux bug.

- Added Steam achievements (your stats should give you some already!)

- Other minor game improvements.

We hope you enjoy them! Tell us what you like the most :D

http://store.steampowered.com/app/702411/EightMinute_Empire_Old_Europe_Map/

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 is here.
notes.notes:
Changes:
- Localization improved
- Zooming & Scrolling improved
- Fixed glitching maps on Mac OS
- Few more tutorial messages added.
- Achievements window improved (filters).
- Every achievement has its own icon now.
- Email notification to room's owner (when there are enough players to start the game) fixed
- Small fixes in AI
- Fixes for Isthmus of Gom map.
- Maps Selection Panel slightly improved.
- Auto-surrendering in sync game fixed.
- Silenced bid buttons when there are more than one local player.
- Credits window added

We are grateful for all the feedback and suggestions we have received. Please note that you can always send as a feedback from the help panel.
